Figure 1: Three types of spurious correlations that mislead agentic memory: (left) observable confounder C creates an X1 (memory cue)-X0 (true causality) association; (middle) same structure but the confounder U is latent.(right) The entry content X3 and the true cause X0 are independent, but both are parents of a collider C⋆. Conditioning on C⋆ makes X3 and X0 conditionally dependent, so X3 becomes spuriously correlated to Y .
